scope: Actual production CLI, local bare Git origin, local HTTP publication and two browser contexts inside an isolated sandbox. GitHub owner identity is simulated; production data and Pages are not edited.

checks.name: production CLI create/edit/delete, actual commit and push to isolated bare origin
unauthorized actor and stale revision rejected without changing remote
saved data published over isolated HTTP, survives reload and second mobile browser context
restore historical Git version, push new commit, republish and refresh both devices
production JSON unchanged and temporary public endpoint is read only
